preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.
Number of rows R is between 2 and 1000.
Number of columns C is between 2 and 1000.
X is between 2 and the minimum of R and C.
Absolute values of elements in matrices A and B are between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all((sum(A[i]) % 2 == sum(B[i])) for i in range(R))
postconditions.description: The parity of the sum of elements in each row of A must match the parity of the sum of elements in the corresponding row of B.

postconditions.expression: all((sum(A[:, j]) % 2 == sum(B[:, j])) for j in range(C))
postconditions.description: The parity of the sum of elements in each column of A must match the parity of the sum of elements in the corresponding column of B.

postconditions.expression: all((A[i][j] + v * k == B[i][j]) for i in range(R) for j in range(C) for v in range(-10**9, 10**9 + 1) for k in range(0, (R + C - X + 1)))
postconditions.description: Each element in A can be transformed to the corresponding element in B by adding a multiple of v to a block of X consecutive elements in the same row or column.
